reverse_engineering.identity: XRed/Synaptics Delphi backdoor with embedded genuine Microsoft .NET installer decoy and KBHks.dll input module.
reverse_engineering.outer_dispatch: CODE offsets 0x95158 onward contain GetCMDAccess, GetScreenImage, ListDisk, ListDir, DownloadFile and DeleteFile. At VA 0x495c80 onward the received string is compared with these labels and dispatched into handlers.
reverse_engineering.hook_module: HookOn at VA 0x403680 installs WH_KEYBOARD=2 and WH_CBT=5 with thread ID zero. The keyboard callback at VA 0x403540 opens/maps a receiver handle and posts wParam/lParam as message 0x1600. HookOff removes both hooks.
reverse_engineering.swarm: Both win32.test.ts files are byte-identical. The encoded text decodes to IEX (New-Object Ondows Nem), a malformed fixture passed to detectPowerShellEscape; the detector performs regex tests, not execution.
reverse_engineering.dependency: graphifyy 0.9.82 wheel sha256 da9550d02d0f63275b7b8514be06a7d64e580d7945c03edc1740a1e63adb6928 verified. Knowledge-graph tool; llm.py uses configured model providers and CLI argv for requested extraction. No credential theft or hidden payload found. Isolated PURL scanned before and after; no suspicious/hostile traits.
reverse_engineering.tools: atomscan and cleave facts on all three originals; rizin PE imports, exports, code and callbacks; binwalk not installed in this environment.

Moved generic resource/GUI/atom/copy/temp/AutoRun API clusters to neutral homes; removed unsupported encryption, injection, infection and propagation claims.
Updated exact consumers. Resource directory ancestor consumers are two neutral-resource downgrade selectors; additions remain appropriate resource evidence.
Tightened autorun-drive-worm with self-image lookup, copy API and an executable autorun directive.
Replaced compiler-suppressed IPC-keylogger composite with global WH_KEYBOARD and key-event forwarding evidence; no compiler/vendor blanket exemption.
limitations: The one unique suspicious PowerShell ID in each benign archive and decoded children is engine-emitted and cannot be changed by YAML.
